title: Ethereum sees biggest exchange withdrawal in four months as October ETF losses top $1 billion
summary: About 169,770 ETH left centralized exchanges on net in one day, Santiment reported Oct. 23, the largest daily withdrawal in more than four months and worth about $407 million at the $2,400 reference price. The last bigger episode came June 5, when roughly 223,800 ETH left exchanges near what Santiment calls a local buying opportunity.… Read the full story on CryptoSlate Understand the crypto stories that matter and what to watch next.
